verdict.rationale: Azure ships an official, cross-platform Azure CLI for managing resources interactively or through scripts. It installs on Windows, Linux and macOS (e.g. via Homebrew), runs in Docker and Cloud Shell, supports tab-completion, and lets you shape output with JMESPath through --query, which suits automated or agent-driven use. A community user independently corroborates that almost everything can be done via the command line. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of agent-oriented CLI features such as documented non-interactive or service-principal auth flows and guaranteed machine-readable output formats.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Azure CLI is a cross-platform command-line tool for managing Azure resources with interactive commands or scripts.
The Azure CLI is available to install in Windows, Linux, and macOS environments. It can also be run in a Docker container and Azure Cloud Shell.
You can use the `--query` parameter and the [JMESPath](http://jmespath.org/) query syntax to customize your output.
We support tab-completion for groups, commands, and some parameters
Almost everything can be done via command line.
